stemMd: What is the range of f(x) = (x − 2)² + 3 for real x?
explanationMd: A square is nonnegative, so f(x) is at least three. At x = 2 the square is zero, attaining that minimum. Every larger value can be produced by choosing an appropriate distance from two.

distractorRationale.c: The square term cannot be negative.
distractorRationale.b: The value three is attained at x = 2.
distractorRationale.a: Three is the minimum, not the maximum.
distractorRationale.d: Other inputs make the square positive and give larger values.
